screen.mnightmares.config.note.server_fi: On a server these settings come from the server's own config file.
option.mnightmares.enable_image.tooltip: Shows the watching eye above the text.
option.mnightmares.hide_chat_when_sleepi: Keeps the chat window out of the way while the overlay is up.
option.mnightmares.user_content_replaces: On, your own nightmares are the only ones shown. Off, they are mixed in with the built-in ones.
option.mnightmares.hide_hud_messages.too: Hides action bar messages while the overlay is up.
option.mnightmares.min_slide_time.toolti: The shortest a single slide can stay on screen.
option.mnightmares.max_slide_time.toolti: The longest a single slide can stay on screen. Each slide picks a random time in between.
option.mnightmares.fade_in.tooltip: How long a new slide takes to appear.
option.mnightmares.fade_out.tooltip: How long the previous slide takes to disappear.
option.mnightmares.overlay_opacity.toolt: How strongly the pulsing red overlay covers the world behind it.
option.mnightmares.text_opacity.tooltip: How solid the slide text looks.
option.mnightmares.image_opacity.tooltip: How solid the eye looks above the text.
option.mnightmares.eye_animation_speed.t: How long each frame of the eye animation stays on screen. Lower values make the eye move faster.
option.mnightmares.text_scale.tooltip: Scales the slide text. Longer texts wrap onto more lines.
option.mnightmares.image_scale.tooltip: Scales the eye. The text below moves with it.
option.mnightmares.reset_phantom_timer.t: When the night is skipped, players who stayed awake also stop attracting phantoms.
option.mnightmares.suppress_vanilla_mess: Hides the built-in "players sleeping" and "skipping night" messages.
